schema_audit.schema_reconciliation_note: 59 total columns = 4 targets + 55 raw input features. 1 feature ('Exertional CP') has zero variance in the 303-patient cohort and is dropped by the preprocessing cleaner, yielding 54 eligible clinical predictive features. After One-Hot encoding of VHD and BBB, the transformed feature matrix has 57 columns.

exp_a.calibration_disclosure: Raw-model SHAP attributions operate in uncalibrated score space (log-odds / margin). For calibrated models, SHAP values linearly reconstruct the ensemble mean score, not the final post-processed calibrated probability.

exp_c.scientific_disclaimer: Empirical fold variability (standard deviation across repeated outer CV folds) measures model stability, not formally calibrated prediction intervals. Entropy quantifies predictive uncertainty given model output p, not frequentist epistemic error.

empirical_fold_variability.methodological_caveat: Quantiles and standard deviations represent empirical across-model variability across correlated training partitions, NOT formally calibrated prediction intervals.

missingness_stress_test.methodological_note: The audited Z-Alizadeh Sani cohort contains zero missing values. This experiment represents a synthetic stress test of the preprocessing pipeline's defensive SimpleImputer behavior under MCAR conditions, not real-world missingness.

scientific_disclaimers: This analysis is exploratory and does NOT constitute a clinical fairness or demographic equity certification.
Sample size guards enforced: Subgroups with N < 30 or min(N+, N-) < 5 are flagged as statistically underpowered, and metrics are masked as None.
Observed metric differences between subgroups reflect clinical heterogeneity, sample size limitations, and unadjusted confounders rather than isolated model bias.
